title: RuneScape Dragonwilds - Saves FIXED? Ranger Buffs & More!
author: Kodeations
description:
RuneScape Dragonwilds - Saves FIXED? Ranged Buffs & More! Jagex just released Update 1.0.1, bringing major save fixes, NEW Ranged special attacks, expanded inventory space, jump attacks, and a TON of quality-of-life improvements! And some of these changes are things players have been asking for since launch!

🔥 **What's NEW in RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0.1?
- Ranged Combat Upgrades: Three new special attacks for Shortbows, Longbows, and Crossbows
- Save Fixes & Recovery: Jagex addresses disappearing world saves and introduces a recovery system for certain corrupted character saves. But are all save issues resolved
- Inventory Expansion: Inventory space increased from 32 to 40 slots
- Death From Above: A new plunging jump attack that scales with your equipped weapon
- New Ranged Perks: Ammo Recovery, Greater Ammo Recovery, and Low Blow
- Quality-of-Life Improvements: Completed quest tracking, improved inventory sorting, a toggle for the Visceral Attack Camera, improved enemy aggro and respawn timers, and new composting upgrades.
- Bug Fixes & Balancing: Scorned Wilderness Raid fixes, quest progression improvements, Kuldra drop fixes, Rune ammunition changes, and much more!

Official Dragonwilds 1.0.1 Patch Notes: https://dragonwilds.runescape.com/news/eye-on-ashenfall-1-0-1
